scope: Full Twofish algorithm article only; no completion claim for Blowfish, AES, the other AES candidates, modes of operation, key management, implementations or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 Twofish 这一种 128 位块、16 轮的 AES 候选分组密码：F/g/h 函数、q0/q1 置换、MDS 与 RS 编码、Me/Mo 密钥调度、小端字节序、输入/输出白化、提交论文附录 A 的三组中间值和 36 条链式向量；不把 Blowfish、AES、其他 AES 候选者、工作模式或整个库并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the 128-bit-block, 16-round Twofish AES candidate: the F/g/h functions, q0/q1 permutations, MDS and RS encoding, Me/Mo key schedule, little-endian byte order, input/output whitening, the three Appendix A intermediate-value traces and the 36 chained vectors. It does not absorb Blowfish, AES, the other AES candidates, modes of operation or the whole library.
